focus: MaxRegions fallback, plant search region cap, Corpse-removal always stopping hunts
diffSource: since build 48 (2026-10-07T05:08:15Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Fallback region limit gives wild/enemy titans 100 regions where vanilla gives 30
findings.detail: MakeMaxRegions' fallback lambda (TitanDiet.cs:190) returns 100 for every non-humanlike pawn and the comment calls that vanilla's plain animal limit. Vanilla GetMaxRegionsToScan returns 100 only for Faction.OfPlayer and 30 for everyone else (FoodUtility.cs:551-562). Change the lambda to `p.RaceProps.Humanlike || all ? -1 : (p.Faction == Faction.OfPlayer ? 100 : 30)` and fix the warning text. Only reached if a game update renames the method.

findings.title: TitanDietProps doc comment still describes the old Corpse/hunts rule
findings.detail: TitanDiet.cs:19-20 says 'Unset: unchanged, except removing Corpse stops hunting'. After this change Build() forces hunts=false whenever Corpse is removed, even if a trait sets hunts=true. Update the comment to say Corpse removal overrides hunts in every case, so XML authors reading the props see the actual rule.

findings.title: Config error covers only a single trait with both settings; a hunts=true trait plus another Corpse-removing trait is dropped silently
findings.detail: TitanTraitDef.cs:218 checks one trait's own diet. Build() merges across traits, so trait A hunts=true combined with trait B removeFoodTypes=Corpse drops A's hunting with no warning anywhere. This is the intended behaviour; it is worth knowing when a user asks why their hunter doesn't hunt.
